defect: A soft different-table rule's satisfaction indicator is bounded only from below (var_a + var_b - sat <= 1), so the maximizer sets it true in every chart and soft keep-apart rules never influence the result.

answer_key.why: The bean's intent is the chart with the highest weighted total of satisfied soft constraints. For same-table rules the indicator is capped (sat + var_a - var_b <= 1), so it can only be true when the rule holds. The different-table branch forces sat true when the guests are together and never forces it false when they are, so Maximize sets it true regardless. Measured on main: a weight-100 keep-apart loses to a weight-1 sit-together. The ac1 test cannot see it because capacity forces the separation. Repaired by bean-021.
